description: This Dart file defines a RealTimeService class for managing WebSocket and SSE (Server-Sent Events) connections with exponential backoff reconnection, JWT authorization, and topic subscription management. It includes helper classes and type definitions for connectivity, message handling, and configuration.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: Helper class for exponential backoff with jitter to manage reconnection delays.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Main class handling WebSocket and SSE connections with topic subscriptions, automatic reconnection with exponential backoff, and JWT authorization.

methods.name: withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method to create a RealtimeService instance with an external token getter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection, trying WebSocket first, then falling back to SSE if WebSocket fails.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribe to a specific topic/channel; sends subscribe command if WebSocket is active or reconnects if using SSE.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribe from a topic/channel; sends command if WebSocket is active or triggers reconnection if using SSE.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes current connection and stops reconnection attempts.

methods.name: _connectWebSocket
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with JWT authorization, handles resubscription.

methods.name: _connectSse
methods.description: Establishes an SSE connection with JWT authorization, handles event stream.

methods.name: _emitParsed
methods.description: Internal method to parse incoming data (JSON or raw string) and emit it through the message stream.

methods.name: _handleDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, triggering reconnection procedures with exponential backoff.

methods.name: _reconnect
methods.description: Performs reconnection attempts with delay based on backoff, prefers WebSocket unless forced to SSE.

methods.name: _teardownWs
methods.description: Cleans up WebSocket connection and subscriptions.

methods.name: _teardownSse
methods.description: Cleans up SSE connection and subscriptions.
